messages:
Maya: Alert from dependency scanner: container base image in infra/ci/Dockerfile uses libc v2.34 with known vuln (CVE-2025-9999). Also SAST flagged a code path that allows CI service-account to write image metadata without tenant tags. Can ops/security triage? :rotating_light:
sec-bot: SAST+DepScan summary for branch feature/ci-updates: 1 HIGH (privilege escalation via CI SA), 1 CRITICAL (vuln in base image), 2 MEDIUM (missing audit metadata). Full report: https://ci.redwood.internal/scans/dep/10021
Ryan: quick context  the CI image build step signs image manifests using keystore.Sign() with the CI service account. If the SA can push manifests without tenant_id, audit logs won't map pushes to tenant. Also the pipeline grants the SA broad registry:write and keystore:sign in infra/iam/*.yaml.
Carla: can you paste the IAM snippet?
Maya: snippet: ```yaml
# infra/iam/ci-sa.yaml
- role: registry.writer
  members:
    - serviceAccount:ci-builder@redwood.svc
- role: keystore.signer
  members:
    - serviceAccount:ci-builder@redwood.svc
```
Jamal: Oof. That's wide. If a dev pipeline is compromised it could push malicious images or sign them, and without tenant_id in keystore audit we lose provenance.
Lucy: reproduction note: I ran a local build with attacker-controlled pipeline variable and could flip image labels. We need to treat this P0 for supply-chain and P1 for compliance.
Maya: immediate actions proposed: 1) rotate CI builder keys and revoke registry write temporarily; 2) patch pipeline to enforce signed-by and require tenant metadata; 3) patch keystore wrapper to require WithAudit(ctx, {tenant_id, pipeline_id, commit}); 4) update IAM roles to least privilege (scoped to repos/namespaces).
infra-bot: NOTE: automated rollback job can revoke registry tokens at 6604567922. Execute? (yes/no)
Ryan: yes, revoke now and block pushes from ci-builder until we have mitigations.
Carla: opening hotfix PR to add kms.WithAudit and to change the sign call: ```go
// pipeline/signer.go
ctx = keystore.WithAudit(ctx, map[string]string{"pipeline_id": pipelineID, "commit": commitSHA})
sig, err := keystore.Sign(ctx, manifest)
```
Jamal: add tenant_id too when pipeline is tenant-scoped. For multi-tenant shared pipelines, require explicit tenant param. No implicit defaults.
Lucy: I'll run a quick scan to list images signed in last 72h and check keystore audit entries for missing tenant_id. If any found, mark for rollback.
sec-bot: Security-block set on PRs touching infra/iam and pipeline signing code. Gate: HIGH findings must be resolved before merge.
Maya: also add CI linter that fails if keystore.Sign is called without a preceding keystore.WithAudit in the same file scope. A regex-based pre-commit is OK short-term.
Ryan: long-term: build SLSA attestation enforcement in registry to require signed attestation with tenant metadata. That prevents unsigned or mis-tagged images from being promoted. I'll spin up infra-issue.
Carla: policy change: any role grant to keystore.signer must include a scope label in IAM or use a constrained key that only signs for a given repo. We should avoid global keystore keys for CI.
Lucy: I found 3 recent publishes by ci-builder with empty tenant fields in audit. I'll open incident ticket and start impact analysis.
Maya: runbook steps: 1) revoke tokens (done), 2) rotate signing keys, 3) revalidate images in production manifests, 4) revert any suspicious image tags, 5) notify partner teams and create postmortem. Assign to oncall-sec.
sec-bot: Incident created: sec-incident/2026-0313-01 - "CI SA image signing without tenant audit" assigned to jamal.
Jamal: I'll take incident lead. Can infra grant me temporary registry admin for investigation and logs?
infra-bot: Temporary elevation request recorded. Approve? (approve/deny)
Ryan: approve for jamal for 4 hours. Keep audit on elevation.
Carla: PR opened: https://git.redwood/internal/p/10112 - locks down IAM, adds keystore.WithAudit wrapper in signer, adds pre-commit linter. Requesting sec review from jamal/maya.
Lucy: post-merge checks: run registry query for images signed in last 7d, cross-check keystore audit for tenant metadata, and run vulnerability scan on base images to address CVE-2025-9999.
Maya: I'll patch Dockerfile to updated base (libc v2.36) and push a rebuild. We should also add a DAST pipeline that runs on CI images before promotion.
Jamal: schedule a blameless postmortem for tomorrow EOD and include timeline: who merged IAM change, when suppression rules were modified, and why SAST gating missed this.
sec-bot: Follow-ups created: sec-workflows#1366 (linter + SLSA), infra#432 (constrain keystore keys), ops#981 (rebuild images).
Maya: thanks team. Closing this thread once incident document and remediation completed. :white_check_mark:
